properties.description: Detect the patten execution of the the brazilian malware Zapgrande
properties.query:
let zip=
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FileName endswith ".zip"
| project DeviceId,ZipTimestamp =Timestamp,ZipFolderPath=FolderPath,ZipFileName=FileName;
let lnk =
DeviceFileEvents
| where ActionType == "FileCreated"
| where FileName endswith ".lnk"
| project DeviceId, LnkTimestamp = Timestamp, LnkFolderPath = FolderPath, LnkFileName = FileName;
let pwsh =
DeviceProcessEvents
| where InitiatingProcessFileName == "cmd.exe"
| where FileName in ("powershell.exe", "POWERSHELL.EXE", "powershell_ise.exe", "POWERSHELL_ISE.EXE")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Net.WebClient","DownloadFile","Invoke-WebRequest","iwr","Invoke-Shellcode","http:",
"New-Object System.Net.Sockets.TcpClient","IEX","Invoke-Expression","DownloadString") or ProcessCommandLine contains "base64" 
or ProcessCommandLine contains "-EcondedCommand" or ProcessCommandLine contains "-enc"
| project DeviceId, PWSHTimestamp = Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, CommandLine_PS = ProcessCommandLine;
zip
| join kind=inner (lnk) on DeviceId
| join kind=inner (pwsh) on DeviceId
| where LnkTimestamp >= ZipTimestamp
| where ZipTimestamp >= PWSHTimestamp
| where PWSHTimestamp between (ZipTimestamp .. 15m)
| project Timestamp_Zip = ZipTimestamp,Timestamp_LNK = LnkTimestamp,Timestamp_PS = PWSHTimestamp,DeviceName,AccountName,ZipFolderPath,
LnkFileName,CommandLine_PS
